versions.statuteQuote: Agrees to pay the landlord's attorney fees except as provided in this chapter

summaryForModel: A lease cannot make the tenant pay the landlord's attorney fees except where the Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act itself allows it. A blanket attorney-fee clause is unenforceable.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant shall pay all of Landlord's attorney fees and costs in any dispute arising under this lease.
In the event of any legal action, Resident will reimburse Owner for legal fees regardless of outcome.
tenantExplanation: Virginia limits when you can be made to pay your landlord's lawyer. A clause making you pay their legal fees in any dispute goes further than the law allows.
action: You can ask your landlord to limit this clause to what Virginia law allows, or remove it.
